scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Raising Capital through SME Exchange
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise run by an SC/ST entrepreneur
The enterprise must have successfully raised equity capital through an SME Exchange
The enterprise must apply within one year from the listing date in the SME Exchange
SC/ST enterprise means the contribution of the SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of up to 30% of the total expenditure (capped at ₹5,00,000) for raising capital through an SME Exchange, with possible equity investment by Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL).
